Low FODMAP Diet Instructions
•	 Consider and look over the list of all high FODMAPs foods. If any of these foods are taken in too much, try cutting them out first.
•	 If symptoms do not improve, avoid all high FODMAPs foods for 6 to 8 weeks.
•	 Fructose containing foods with a 1:1 ratio of fructose to glucose are usually well tolerated as opposed to foods with excess fructose compared to 
glucose.
